messages:
Zara Kim: hi everyone :wave: i'm zara, joined today as an SRE (she/her). relocated from seattle and working hybrid. i bake focaccia badly but enthusiastically. excited to meet folks and learn the stack!
Liam Park: welcome zara!! :tada: we have a plant watering rota and a legendary office sourdough club  if you're into baking you'll fit right in.
Sasha Gomez: hi zara!! also curious where you prefer lunch — i'm organizing a small noon poll so we can order together.
Zara Kim: @Sasha hahah yes please. i eat everything except cilantro. :grimacing:
Liam Park: tiny poll: choose one emoji for today's lunch order 
Sasha Gomez: 1) :pizza: 2) :bento: 3) :taco: 4) :salad:
Zara Kim: 2 please (bento)
Onboarding Bot: Welcome Zara! Don't forget badge pickup and laptop provisioning. Helpful links: <https://intranet/onboard|onboarding checklist>. Reply "help" for assistance.
Facilities Bot: Desk OG-12 assigned. Shared fridge rules: label perishables, remove after 7 days.
Liam Park: FYI we have a small orchid on desk OG-14 that needs occasional watering 
0 if you want to be a temporary plant parent, volunteers welcome.
Zara Kim: i'll happily water ~ every other week if needed 
0 and can bring focaccia to celebrate surviving the first week.
Sasha Gomez: perfect! i'll add you to the lunch thread and plant rota. feel free to ping me for walkthroughs.
Liam Park: welcome again, and if you want a quick repo tour, i'll spare you the most embarrassing bits of my dotfiles live demo :sweat_smile:
Zara Kim: lol i'll take the tour. thanks everyone :heart:
